_schema: LEGEND governance v3.1.1 · Annex A.1 TASK_ASSIGNMENT
_note: Part of the ten-hour repurposing batch ORCH-REPURPOSING-10H-20261021. Adjacent and transferable literature: every paper that is not WWOX evidence is labelled NOT WWOX EVIDENCE, at class level, no dose, no paediatric suitability presumed, not medical advice.
OBJECTIVE: Roadmap P4 for the RECUPERO_PROFONDO path, from the repository's OWN qualified records and with no new literature reading unless a card is decided by one panel: produce the first candidate cards (or explicit abstentions) with framework/scripts/repurposing_bridge.py, drawing on the known-roads note, the R1 note and its verdicts on the three historic dossiers, the R3 note, the rescue-reference scaffold and the clinical census.

SCOPE.outputs: disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/cards/ (new subdirectory, yours alone), one JSON packet per candidate plus the cards the bridge builds, and a README beside them

ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: every card carries the roadmap's P4 fields, with UNKNOWN rather than absent
a card for an axis with no support is an explicit abstention naming the missing datum
no score, no ranking, no probability, no dose, no paediatric suitability
at least one card or abstention per axis the repository can support, and the Q230P recovery axis treated first
DELIVERABLE: manifests, staged receipt JSONs, commit candidates, analysis note, self-eval

TASK_ACK.understanding: Roadmap P4 for RECUPERO_PROFONDO: shape the repository's own qualified material (known roads, R1, R3, rescue reference, clinical census) into candidate cards with framework/scripts/repurposing_bridge.py, Q230P-class recovery axis first, an explicit abstention for every axis without support; no score, rank, probability, dose, route, schedule or paediatric suitability; no new literature reading unless one panel decides a card; the bridge is not patched, gaps are recorded.

TASK_CLAIM.note: No paper is read in this task; no reading claim is taken. Outputs only under disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/cards/ and the note.
